title: The Intern
synopsis:
Young CEO, Sun-woo(played by Han So Hee), the 10 billion revenue legend in just three years making her brand WOO22(Woo-two-two) a dark horse in fashion, has been working flat-out for the success meets her company’s new senior intern Ki-ho(played by Choi Min Shik).

 

Even though he’s a man with 37 years of experience, Ki-ho struggles at WOO22 adjusting himself to the digital workplace and freewheeling office culture. But thanks to Ki-ho’s diligence and down-to-earth personality, Sun-woo gradually opens up to him, and two, completely different in every possible way, share POVs and experiences that they lack in each other, which eventually brings an unexpected warmth in their hectic everyday lives…

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
年青女總裁宣羽（韓韶禧 飾）僅花三年便締造出一百億營業額神話，將自家品牌「WOO22」打造成時裝界黑馬。這位工作狂瞓身追求業務突破，直至遇上公司新加入的高齡見習生基浩（崔岷植 飾）。

 

縱使擁有37年工作經驗，「WOO22」的數碼化工作環境與隨心所欲的辦公室文化，對基浩來說非常陌生。然而，憑藉勤奮及務實作風，宣羽漸漸對他改觀。這兩個本質截然不同的人，互相補足彼此缺乏的觀點與經驗，在忙碌的工作日常中，為彼此注入意想不到的溫暖…
